user_request: Map the buying and adoption system for Queueboard. Explain the likely decision path, unresolved blockers, and useful next questions before proposing a launch audience.

trusted_context.authority: Read-only analysis. The intended buyer is a multi-site service company; no purchase, pilot, or outreach is approved.

source_records.text: Operations champion wants a ten-site trial. Frontline supervisors would use the queue daily but cannot approve spending. Two supervisors worry duplicate entry will add work.
Finance controls the budget and requests measured avoided overtime. Security can block data access and disallows shared accounts. No named-account setup has been tested.
Purchase-order processing takes 25 business days after approved budget and security review. The champion says everyone is excited; neither approval is recorded. Site managers own training schedules.
